name: ctrl-alt-delegate-vscode
description: Reports editor activity (never file names or code) to the local Ctrl Alt Delegate Discord presence service.
author: NovusQuest Studio

ctrlAltDelegate.enabled.description: Report this window's editing activity to the local Ctrl Alt Delegate service.

ctrlAltDelegate.idleMinutes.description: Minutes without editing before this window shows as idle.

ctrlAltDelegate.closeAfterMinutes.description: Minutes without editing before this window's session is cleared.

scripts.package: npm run build && vsce package --no-dependencies --allow-missing-repository --out ctrl-alt-delegate-vscode.vsix
